name: geniechat-server
description: Linux app-server for GenieChat: supervises llama-server, runs the tool loop, serves the react-native-web UI.
//: Deliberately separate from the RN app's package.json. The Android build must not be able to break because of a server dependency, and vice versa. Runtime dependencies: none — this runs on Node 20's stdlib alone, because the board has no network to install anything from.
